title: Neurodegenerative Differential Diagnosis with Knowledge-enhanced Structural Reasoning
abstract: arXiv:2611.27427v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Accurate differential diagnosis of neurodegenerative disorders remains challenging due to overlapping clinical manifestations and heterogeneous, often incomplete multimodal observations. Existing multimodal models can integrate imaging and clinical measurements but often overlook disease-specific evidence patterns and pairwise relations among competing diagnoses. We therefore propose Knowledge-enhanced Structural Reasoning (KnowSR), which aligns multimodal patient representations with a literature-grounded knowledge bank of disease prototypes, signed evidence directions, and pairwise diagnostic relations. Specifically, in KnowSR, patient-specific knowledge alignment and target-aware pooling inject structured disease evidence, while anchored relational reasoning reconciles pairwise diagnostic margins over a sparse differential graph, thereby collectively enhancing differential diagnostic capability. translated_title: 基于知识增强结构化推理的神经退行性疾病鉴别诊断
translated_abstract: 由于神经退行性疾病的临床表现相互重叠，且多模态观测数据异构且常常不完整，其准确的鉴别诊断仍然充满挑战。现有的多模态模型虽然能够整合影像与临床测量数据，但往往忽视了疾病特异性的证据模式以及竞争性诊断之间的两两关系。因此，我们提出了知识增强结构化推理，将多模态患者表征与一个基于文献构建的知识库对齐，该知识库包含疾病原型、带符号的证据方向以及两两诊断关系。具体而言，在KnowSR中，患者特定的知识对齐与目标感知池化注入结构化的疾病证据，而锚定关系推理则在稀疏的鉴别图上协调两两诊断边界，从而共同增强鉴别诊断能力。在大量实验中，KnowSR……
tldr: 提出了知识增强结构化推理框架KnowSR，通过将多模态患者表征与基于文献的疾病知识库（疾病原型、带符号证据方向和两两诊断关系）对齐，注入结构化疾病证据并在稀疏鉴别图上进行关系推理，从而提升神经退行性疾病的鉴别诊断能力。
en_tdlr: We propose KnowSR, a knowledge-enhanced structural reasoning framework that aligns multimodal patient representations with a literature-grounded knowledge bank of disease prototypes, signed evidence directions, and pairwise diagnostic relations, thereby improving differential diagnosis of neurodegenerative disorders.
